outcome: Cesarean delivery due to non-reassuring fetal status
cohort: 184 small for gestational age (SGA) fetuses between 34 and 41 weeks gestational age, who were less than the 5th percentile
finding: Abnormal CPR with abnormal umbilical artery PI increases the risk of cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal status in severe SGA fetuses of late preterm and term.
mod_finding: Abnormal CPR with abnormal PI of UmA increases the risk of cesarean delivery for non-reassuring fetal status, in severe SGA fetuses of late preterm and term.
